description: This file defines the interface for webpa communication and WAN failover support in the lan manager component. It includes function declarations, macros, and type definitions relevant to web interface operations and conditional WAN failover features.
external_methods: rbus/rbus.h (implying functions from the rbus library)

methods.name: sendWebpaMsg
methods.description: Send a message to WebPA and upstream entities with specified service, destination, transaction ID, content type, payload, and payload length.

methods.name: getDeviceMac
methods.description: Retrieve the device's MAC address by querying the stack.

methods.name: getFullDeviceMac
methods.description: Retrieve the device's full MAC address by querying the stack.

methods.name: initparodusTask
methods.description: Initialize the Parodus task for communication.

methods.name: checkRbusEnabled
methods.description: Check if RBus (Remote Bus) communication is enabled.

methods.name: lmliteRbusInit
methods.description: Initialize RBus communication for the component.

methods.name: get_WanManager_ActiveInterface
methods.description: Get the active WAN interface managed by WAN Manager.

methods.name: get_ActiveInterface
methods.description: Get the currently active network interface.

methods.name: subscribeTo_InterfaceActiveStatus_Event
methods.description: Subscribe to events related to interface active status.
